mapper.insert: insert into question ( question_no, exam_no, question_content, question_score, question_comment, question_order ) values ( #{questionNo}, #{examNo}, #{questionContent}, #{questionScore}, #{questionComment}, #{questionOrder} )
mapper.select: select * from question where exam_no = #{examNo} order by question_order asc
mapper.update: update question set question_content = #{questionContent}, question_score = #{questionScore}, question_comment = #{questionComment}, question_order = #{questionOrder} where question_no = #{questionNo}
mapper.select: select attach_no from question_file where question_no = #{questionNo} order by attach_no asc
